sanskrit_verse:
यस्य त्रिपुरुषा भुक्तिः पारंपर्यक्रमागता ।
न सा चालयितुं शक्या पूर्वकाच्छासनाद् ऋते ॥
transliteration: yasya tripuruṣā bhuktiḥ pāraṃparyakramāgatā / na sā cālayituṃ śakyā pūrvakāc chāsanād ṛte //
sph_interpretive_translation: That enjoyment which has come through three generations in orderly succession—such cannot be disturbed except by the command of the prior authority.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows sequentially through established lineage
Continuity of enjoyment establishes de facto right
Disruption of settled enjoyment requires explicit counter-command
Responsibility aligns with the source of original directive
Consciousness recognizes stability as a form of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF an enjoyment has persisted across three successive generations THEN it is legally stabilized UNTIL countermanded by prior originating authority
IF no explicit revocation from foundational authority EXISTS THEN continuity of possession remains inviolate
IF disruption is proposed THEN verification of superior command authority MUST precede any judicial action
IF enjoyment is unbroken THEN capacity for ownership is deemed intact AND restoration shall support continuation
supreme_court_application: In adjudication at the highest level, when enjoyment or possession has endured across three generations without contest, the court must recognize this as prima facie evidence of lawful continuity. Only upon presentation of clear directive from the originating or superseding authority can such a status be lawfully altered. The burden lies on disturbance, not defense.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse reflects pramāṇa-based causality where uninterrupted sequence (anupūrvaśaḥ) creates a field of stabilized dharma. It aligns with Nyaya through recognition of cause-effect chains rooted in authoritative initiation. Responsibility resides with the countermanding agent, not the holder. There is no punitive element; only realignment to source-command when required.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Verification protocol for ancestral chain of title
Reconnection process between current possessor and originating authority
Completion mechanism ensuring no disturbance without higher authorization
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma is hereby restored. Enjoyment stabilized across generational continuity stands affirmed unless superseded by explicit command from prior originative authority. Reality operates without punishment; consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
